ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is titled “TERRESTRIAL FOOD WEB.” It shows labeled organisms including Grasses at the bottom, insects, shrew, mouse, rabbit, deer, snake, and cougar. Arrows go from Grasses toward several animals, showing that grasses are at the base of the food web. Reasoning: A producer is an organism that makes its own food, usually a plant. In this diagram, the plant shown is Grasses, so the producer is Grass.
